cd /private/var/folders/vl/g_dyzwvs4_52rz0rdks_3j900000gp/T/bench-tmp-w7wtasw2/rp && rm -f Package.swift && mkdir -p App && cat > App/App.swift <<'EOF'
import SwiftUI

    var body: some Scene {
        WindowGroup { Text("runner") }
    }
}

cat > project.yml <<'EOF'
name: RepostTap
options:
  bundleIdPrefix: com.example
settings:
  base:
    SWIFT_VERSION: 5.0
    CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED: NO
    CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: ""
targets:

    type: application
    platform: iOS
    deploymentTarget: "16.0"
    sources: [App]
    info:
      path: App/Info.plist
      properties:
        CFBundleName: RepostRunner
        UILaunchScreen: {}
  RepostUITests:
    type: bundle.ui-testing
    platform: iOS
    deploymentTarget: "16.0"
    sources: [Tests]
    dependencies:
      - target: RepostRunner
EOF
